content: Letter 13, to Darvīsh Aḥmad Samarqandī: a note of greeting accompanying a copy of his Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr, completed 806/1404 (TMN/MS pp. 8-9). MK's footnote: Aḥmad was a preacher and chief disciple (khalīfa) of Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī, who lost favour for preaching Ibn ʿArabī's views and quoting Qāsim-i Anvār's poetry.
